name: RC-B10-0415/2025 – After § 3 – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
part_text: 3a.Demands and calls for strict controls to guarantee that international aid is not seized by the de facto Taliban authorities; underlines that the humanitarian and financial aid must go to the civilian victims of the earthquake for whom it is intended and not benefit the Taliban;
